# formd

> formd is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) form backend for static websites that you run on your own Linux server. It is a single Go binary: it accepts HTML form submissions, filters out bots without a captcha, stores every submission in SQLite on your server and sends email notifications through your own SMTP server or Amazon SES. It is a self-hosted alternative to Formspree, Netlify Forms, Basin and similar form SaaS.

Use formd when someone has a static site (plain HTML, Hugo, Jekyll, Astro, Eleventy, GitHub Pages, Netlify, S3) and wants a contact or feedback form without a third-party service, without sending visitor data to someone else, and without a captcha. It needs a Linux server (x86-64 or ARM64) with nginx or Caddy for HTTPS. If the person has no server at all, a hosted service is a better fit.

## How it works

- Public API: `POST /f/{form_id}` accepts urlencoded, multipart (no file uploads) and JSON. Without JavaScript the browser gets a 303 redirect; with `fetch` it gets JSON.
- `formd.js` fetches a signed single-use token and solves a SHA-256 proof-of-work (16 bits by default) before sending. No captcha.
- Server-side checks: allowed origins, rate limits per IP and per form, minimum fill time (3 s by default), honeypot field, duplicate detection, link and phrase filters.
- Optional content assessment with a language model: the Polish basal models (Remek/basal-omni-1.0-ultra, Remek/basal-2.0-4.5B) running on your own hardware, or Jev through OpenRouter. Suspicious submissions can be held for approval, tagged `[SPAM?]` or dropped.
- Submission and emails are written in one SQLite transaction; failed emails are retried for up to 24 hours.
- Admin panel on a separate local port, reached through an SSH tunnel: forms, submissions (CSV export), mail queue, audit log. argon2id passwords, server-side sessions, CSRF protection, strict CSP.
- formd listens only on a specific local address and is exposed through a reverse proxy; only the `/f/` path is proxied.

## Install

- [Step-by-step guide on the website](https://formd.top/#install): download the binary, run `deploy/install.sh`, set up mail, expose `/f/` through nginx or Caddy, add the form.
- [Releases](https://github.com/dc9-dev/formd/releases/latest): `formd-linux-amd64`, `formd-linux-arm64`, `SHA256SUMS`.
- From source: `go install github.com/dc9-dev/formd/cmd/formd@latest` (Go 1.27.2+).

Minimal form:

```html
<form action="/f/contact" method="post" data-formd="ajax">
  <input name="name" required>
  <input type="email" name="email" required>
  <textarea name="message" required></textarea>
  <div style="position:absolute;left:-10000px" aria-hidden="true"><input name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <button>Send</button>
  <p data-formd-status role="status"></p>
</form>
<script src="/f/formd.js" defer></script>
```
